intent: Research MS-0112 as a bounded cross-industry proof that hyperscaler capital/infrastructure spending and server CPU/platform transitions are distinct upstream demand drivers for server DRAM and enterprise SSD. Reuse the existing grounded Microsoft/Micron cross-industry packet, add only claim-scoped server-platform-cycle evidence that is materially missing, preserve capex, server/platform transition, DRAM demand/content and enterprise-SSD demand as separate scopes, and create no synthetic causal scalar unless a source explicitly supplies the bridge.
rationale_summary: The repository already contains grounded Microsoft cloud/AI capex-and-server-spend evidence and Micron hyperscale SSD demand evidence, so repeating a generic AI-demand packet would add little. The missing MS-0112 increment is the server CPU/platform-cycle axis and, only where explicitly sourced, its memory-content or storage-demand bridge. Existing source preservation, Evidence, bounded research orchestration and execution owners can represent this without new semantic ownership.
